name: Shirmani Reconciliation Audit Trail
purpose: Define evidence-backed reconciliation records that compare settlement/payment records with accounting or external reconciliation evidence.

state_rules.PENDING: Reconciliation record exists but evidence has not been checked.
state_rules.EVIDENCE_CHECK: Payment/settlement and accounting evidence are under comparison.
state_rules.MATCHED: Relevant evidence agrees for the recorded fields; this is not by itself an independent audit.
state_rules.RECONCILED: Required payment and accounting/reconciliation evidence are present.
state_rules.EXCEPTION: A mismatch or missing evidence blocks normal reconciliation.
state_rules.NOT_VERIFIED: Evidence cannot establish the claimed reconciliation state.

integrity_rules: No invented transaction, payment, amount, balance, actor, evidence, or reconciliation result.
RECONCILED requires payment evidence and accounting/reconciliation evidence.
A mismatch must remain an exception until resolved through documented review.
An open blocking dispute prevents automatic closure.
Audit entries record changes and corrections rather than silently overwriting prior state.
This schema does not perform bank reconciliation or constitute an independent financial/legal audit.
AI-generated summaries are not reconciliation evidence by themselves.
Privacy boundary: store only necessary references and avoid unnecessary personal or financial data.
